official_boundary.api: YouTube Data API v3 channels.list, videos.insert resumable upload and videos.list
official_boundary.classification: YouTube determines Shorts eligibility after ordinary video upload; there is no separate Shorts publishing endpoint

implemented: single bound-channel identity and capability discovery
title, description, privacy and required audience validation
tenant-scoped MP4 byte loading and official HTTPS resumable-session boundary
resumable session initialization and exact-byte transfer
processing, rejection, missing-video and completed-upload reconciliation
auth, quota, transient, policy, permanent and ambiguous-result normalization
deferred_live_gates: Owner approval for a named Google Cloud project, enabled YouTube Data API and OAuth consent/scope action
Owner approval before adding or changing that application's credentials
Owner approval before authorizing a named YouTube channel
Separate owner approval naming the channel, MP4, title, description, privacy and audience before any real upload/publication
limitations: No real account, credential, API request, upload or external publication was used in local qualification
The approved project's current audit status, quota and channel-specific restrictions must be re-qualified before live acceptance
A lost upload response remains ambiguous and must be reconciled rather than repeated blindly
